purpose: raw multi-pose acquisition for Codex gravity/load identification; no model fit here

robot.joints: J1-J4 gravity DOF; J5 fixed end mass, not a joint
robot.power_can: J1-J3 series group; J4-J5 series group

sessions.name: A
sessions.status: partial: 9/10 waypoint windows sampled; final waypoint stopped/global-stop; final return not absolute zero

sessions.name: A2
sessions.status: complete 6/6 sampled; final relative zero (returns to session start, not absolute zero)

sessions.name: B2
sessions.status: complete 7/7 sampled; final relative zero (returns to session start, not absolute zero)

sessions.name: C
sessions.status: complete 8/8 sampled; final waypoint is absolute (0,0,0,0,0) and passed
sessions.use: preferred complete session with absolute zero return

notes: Raw JSONL contains controller_state and dynamic records at ~100 Hz; t is recorder-relative.
Use client waypoint_results and initial_model_rad for target/pose association.
effort is the DAMIAO torque estimate, NOT measured current.
Total supply current max reported ~0.65 A; no per-axis current.
No model coefficients, feedforward, or deployment are included.
